changelog:
- Migrated to the redfox.hk API for X (Twitter) video parsing and download.
- Now provides instant watermark-free video download links for single X/Twitter video tweets.
- Batch/video info/audio download features are removed; one link per request is supported.
- Updated usage: requires a redfox.hk API key; set via environment, CLI argument, or config file.
- English documentation added; streamlined instructions and simplified functionality.
